hooks.command: input=$(cat); session_id=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); lockdir="/tmp/claude-pagosya-stop-nudge"; mkdir -p "$lockdir"; lockfile="$lockdir/$session_id"; if [ -f "$lockfile" ]; then exit 0; fi; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$head" ]; then exit 0; fi; dirty=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); last=$(grep -o 'last-updated-commit: [a-f0-9]*' HANDOFF.md 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); if [ "$head" = "$last" ] && [ -z "$dirty" ]; then exit 0; fi; touch "$lockfile"; echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Before ending this session, update HANDOFF.md at the repo root: summarize current problems/open issues, what changed this session, and overall project state. Keep it concise (skim-able in under a minute) and DON'T just repeat what README.md already documents. Update the <!-- last-updated-commit: HASH --> comment at the top to $head. Then finish normally without asking for confirmation.\"}"
